site.reference_frame: MEAN_ME (DE421 surface coordinates; LOLA terrain; DE441 ephemerides)

time_range.time_step_precision: Linear crossing estimates from 1.00h sampling; short events may be missed.

scientific_model_notes: Geometric Earth visibility does not guarantee an RF link; sunlight visibility is not electrical power.
No sunlight in an interval does not establish permanent shadow; eclipses are not modeled.
Terrain coverage is checked at every sampled point; terrain beyond the finite search radius remains unmodeled.
Target center visibility is the primary line-of-sight model (clearance > 0°).
Finite angular diameter effects: Earth mean radius ~0.95°, Sun radius ~0.267°.
Partial limb grazing is classified separately from complete illumination and full blockage.
No window duration exceeds the total observation interval.
LOLA and Horizons lunar coordinates are used without a fitted frame transformation; independent frame validation remains required.

earth_comm.transition_estimation_method: Linear clearance root interpolation between adjacent samples.
earth_comm.sampling_uncertainty_note: Linear crossing estimates depend on sampling; short events can be missed between samples.

solar_power.transition_estimation_method: Linear clearance root interpolation between adjacent samples.
solar_power.sampling_uncertainty_note: Linear crossing estimates depend on sampling; short events can be missed between samples.
